strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: check di current keybox against Google's revocation list (CRL) an try multiple sources until it find a valid keybox, wid an automatic backup an a restart a Google services. Run pan every tap an need internet (1-3 minutes).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox fram network: downloads a keybox fram di official repository (GitHub) an save it to /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Needs internet an tek 1-3 minutes. Used wen di smart fetch fail or wen di keybox did change manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: check di available Remote Key Provisioning modules, inspect di TEE attestation certificate version, an show di KmInstallKeybox tool state. No change notn — a plain device status view.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): show Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) fram dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, an related system properties. Modify nutten at all.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues wen di automatic pass fail. Every run print a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handle di hard cases an tek longer. A clear result appear at di end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: clear Play Store an Google services (GMS+GSF) data an reboot di device automatically. Fi stubborn attestation only — it neva touch yuh photos or files.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: check di RKP certificate attestation state a di device an reset di attestation properties if needed. No touch user data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fix Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used fi some devices weh rely pan SOTER instead a Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies di fingerprint weh yuh select (local/advanced) an update di pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appear inna di log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: shows di installed engine state, di fingerprint files (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), an di logs. Check only — it nuh modifie nutten.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches di latest Canary Engine release fi mek sure compatibility wid di mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: check di TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), di keybox files (active vs user), di real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.hintKbSlots: Di module manage two keybox slots: di primary (sacred, neva wiped) an di secondary (backup). Dis tab shuo wich slot active, switch di preference, or promote di secondary tu primary pan explicit request — wid backups an a full log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: check di TEE key import, di library injection inside keystore2, di revocation status (CRL), di protection-list coverage an di RKP state. Read-only — it nuh change nutten.

• Notn is deleted — di operation is reversible.
